features.context: Actual household income (amount, sources, and stability)
features.selected_text: What is your household income group?

features.context: Disposable income after debt service (loans, medical debt)
Liquid assets and savings (buffers matter for perceived security)
In-kind benefits (housing subsidies, food assistance, family support)
Income volatility (irregular income feels different than stable income at the same annual level)
features.selected_text: Is the main earner in your household currently self-employed, working in a family business, or working for an outside employer?

features.context: Household size and composition (adults, children, elderly, dependents)
Special needs/requirements (chronic illness, disability, childcare costs, eldercare)
features.selected_text: How easy or difficult is it to access childcare?

features.context: Housing costs relative to income (often the largest expenditure)
Geographic cost of living (urban vs. rural, regional price variations)
features.selected_text: Do you live in a rural or urban area?

features.context: Life cycle stage (new parents vs. empty nesters have different 'needs' at similar incomes)
Comparison groups (do they compare themselves to neighbors, past self, or media portrayals?)
features.selected_text: As compared to your parents' generation, does your generation have more or fewer opportunities to improve the standard of living or social status?

features.context: Prior economic experiences (downward mobility vs. upward trajectory affects satisfaction)
features.selected_text: How does your family's current economic condition compare to what it was a few years ago?

features.context: Expectations and aspirations (adaptation level theory—people adjust expectations to their circumstances)
features.selected_text: How do you think your family's economic situation will be a few years from now?

features.context: Definition of 'needs' vs. 'wants' (culturally and individually variable; some view internet/smartphones as essential, others as luxuries)
Employment stability (contract vs. permanent work)
Social safety net access (unemployment insurance, healthcare coverage, pension security)
features.selected_text: How easy or difficult is it to obtain healthcare?

features.context: Perceived economic vulnerability (fear of shocks matters as much as current adequacy)
features.selected_text: How worried are you that your family might lose its major source of income within the next 12 months?

features.context: Age and generation (different standards of 'satisfactory')
features.selected_text: What is your year of birth?

features.context: Education level (affects earning expectations and consumption norms)
features.selected_text: What is your highest level of education?

features.context: Cultural norms (collectivist vs. individualist definitions of household responsibility)
features.selected_text: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement: 'For the sake of the family, the individual should put his personal interests second'?

features.context: Macroeconomic context (recession vs. growth periods shift perceptions of adequacy)
features.selected_text: How do you think the country's economic condition changed over the last few years?
